data.name: Vishvakarma
data.gender_notes: Vishvakarma is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The divine architect and creator of the universe, Vishvakarma, is known for his immense knowledge and skill in designing and building everything from temples and palaces to cosmic structures. The name Vishvakarma carries the meaning “Universal Architect and Creator” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Vishvakarma usually hope their child will grow to embody universal architect and creator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine craftsmanship and creativity, Vishvakarma represents the power of design and creation that exists within all of us.
data.etymology: Vishvakarma belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Universal Architect and Creator.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vishvakarma total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: Vishvakarma is a revered deity in Hindu culture, known as the divine architect and creator of the universe. He is considered the master of all architects and builders, and his name is synonymous with artistry, creativity, and craftsmanship. Vishvakarma's story and legacy have influenced the design and construction of countless temples, palaces, and other monumental structures in India and beyond, as his image is invoked to inspire perfect artistry and precise craftsmanship.
data.spiritual_significance: Vishvakarma holds a significant spiritual position in Hinduism as the divine architect and constructor of the universe. He is believed to have created all living beings, the cosmos, and the various manifestations of the divine. His name is invoked in religious ceremonies and rituals to invoke his blessings for creative endeavors, artistic pursuits, and the construction of temples or other sacred structures. Vishvakarma is seen as the embodiment of divine intelligence and the creative force behind the universe, inspiring a deep reverence and appreciation for the wonders of creation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vishvakarma is the divine architect and creator in Hindu mythology. His name signifies 'all-pervading workmanship' or 'universal craftsmanship'. He is revered for his exquisite design and construction skills, symbolizing the divine power of creation and transformation.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Vishvakarma is the divine architect in Hindu mythology. The name Vishvakarma carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Vishvakarma is considered the creator of the universe and all living beings, and is invoked before starting any construction work.

modern_usage.modern_context: Vishvakarma Puja is a Hindu festival celebrated on the first day of the Shukla Paksha (waxing moon period) in the Hindu calendar month of Bhadra (September–October). It is dedicated to Lord Vishvakarma, the divine architect and creator of the universe.
